style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly. Two or three recognizable engineered parts: a heavy industrial limit switch and a physical governor latch locking down a sleek server bay cover. Hard clean edges, matte muted palette of deep charcoal and brushed aluminum, soft even studio lighting, gallery-print calm. Deliberate arrangement stating the idea of a hard ceiling. Generous negative space, 16:9 wide framing, no text or bare geometry.
